question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a gold ball, Bob has a pink ball, Claire has a grey ball, Dave has a silver ball, and Eve has a yellow ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Finally, Claire and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) gold ball
(B) pink ball
(C) grey ball
(D) silver ball
(E) yellow ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: gold, pink, grey, silver, yellow.
After Claire–Eve: gold, pink, yellow, silver, grey.
After Claire–Dave: gold, pink, silver, yellow, grey.
After Claire–Eve: gold, pink, grey, yellow, silver.
After Claire–Alice: grey, pink, gold, yellow, silver.
After Claire–Dave: grey, pink, yellow, gold, silver.
Alice has the grey ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
